title: RemoteEvent:FireAllClients()
summary: Server → every connected client at once. The standard broadcast: round state, announcements, shared effects.

explanation.whatItIs: The loudspeaker: one call reaches every player.
explanation.whyItExists: Shared game state (round phase, boss health, countdown) must reach everyone — looping FireClient manually is slower and misses joiners.
whenToUse: Shared visual events (lightning strike everyone sees)
whenNotToUse: Personal data — FireClient to the individual
Huge payloads per player when only one changes — bandwidth scales with player count
tips: Joiners AFTER a broadcast don't receive it — send fresh state on PlayerAdded
Keep broadcasts small and infrequent-ish; they multiply by player count
commonMistakes: Broadcasting secrets (enemy positions in hide-and-seek!) — every client = every exploiter
Forgetting late joiners missed the message

examples.title: Round countdown broadcast
examples.code:
-- Server:
local remote = game.ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.GameState

for t = 5, 1, -1 do
    remote:FireAllClients("Countdown", t)
    task.wait(1)
end
remote:FireAllClients("RoundStart")

-- Client:
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, value)
    if kind == "Countdown" then
        print("Starting in", value)
    elseif kind == "RoundStart" then
        print("GO!")
    end
end)
